_meta.description: Official operational status and incident-history source index. This file records where to check current service health; it does not store live uptime or incident state.
_meta.scopeNote: Static reference only. CloudIntelMatrix links to official provider status pages and does not fetch, cache, rank, or summarize live operational state at runtime.
